cases.title: Review webhook trust boundaries
cases.request: Evaluate the trust boundaries around our incoming webhooks and recommend a safer service design.
cases.notes: The canonical registry assigns architecture and security review to architecture-security-advisor.

cases.title: Assess tenant isolation
cases.request: Assess whether the proposed multi-tenant design keeps customer data isolated across services.
cases.notes: This is a system architecture and security-boundary assessment.

cases.title: Evaluate deployment isolation
cases.request: Review the deployment isolation plan for the worker service and identify architectural security risks.
cases.notes: Logical routing remains with the approved owner even when its configured runtime is unverified.

cases.title: Review file-upload security design
cases.request: Analyze the architecture for safely accepting user-uploaded files, including containment and authorization boundaries.
cases.notes: The request asks for security and architecture review, both approved capabilities.

cases.title: Assess a migration design
cases.request: Assess the architectural risks of moving the billing data store and preserving least-privilege access during the migration.
cases.notes: This combines system architecture assessment with an explicit security review concern.

cases.title: Design service authorization
cases.request: Recommend an authorization architecture for service-to-service calls across the internal platform.
cases.notes: Authorization architecture is within the approved architecture and security ownership.

cases.title: Fix a TypeScript implementation bug
cases.request: Find and fix the null-handling bug in this TypeScript function and return the corrected code.
cases.notes: Technical language alone does not establish approved architecture or security ownership; this is an implementation task.

cases.title: Compare cloud prices
cases.request: Compare the monthly cost of running this workload on three cloud providers and recommend the cheapest option.
cases.notes: Cloud infrastructure wording is not itself an approved architecture or security ownership signal.

cases.title: Write a data export query
cases.request: Write a SQL query that exports last quarter's customer transactions grouped by region.
cases.notes: The request is database implementation work, not an architecture or security review.

cases.title: Draft a customer announcement
cases.request: Draft a concise email announcing the new customer dashboard and explaining its benefits.
cases.notes: No approved registry specialist owns customer communications.

cases.title: Build a sales forecast
cases.request: Use these monthly figures to forecast next quarter's sales and summarize the expected revenue.
cases.notes: The canonical registry has no approved sales or forecasting owner.

cases.title: Prepare a hiring interview
cases.request: Create interview questions and a scoring rubric for hiring a customer-support manager.
cases.notes: No approved specialist owns recruiting or human-resources work.
